_comment: Allowlist. Only repos listed here with enabled=true can appear in Featured projects or Recent activity. Anything not listed is never shown. State must be one of: Shipped, Built-unpublished, Designed. 'Proposed' is refused by the script. Forks and private repos are refused even if listed.

projects.name: EEG spectral and coherence analysis
projects.summary: Exploratory Python script: epoching, FFT, power spectral density, cross-spectrum, coherence, phase shift. Runs on a simulated signal; not validated on recorded headset data.

projects.name: NVIDIA Video-to-Data challenge, Track 1 baseline
projects.summary: Reproducible setup plus a deterministic generator that produced a format-valid Track 1 submission scored on all five metrics. A placeholder baseline, not a reconstruction method.
